note: Pinned ws-print-lint --source kit findings per skill at size M (IMPROVEMENT_PLAN §1.4 S1: the --skill row lints at S / M / L; LESSONS_LEARNED L1). Same format and rules as print-lint.json (size L): ws-precritic passes --baseline only when every skill in scope is pinned here; a skill not listed runs unpinned at M, so any finding fails. Lower a count when fixed; never raise one without a STATUS note.
how: ws-print-lint --source kit --size M --skills <the 20 role-sample skills + subtraction:sub_100_no_regroup> --report-only --json; trimmed (lint, rule, sev, page, msg). Extend with the same command for more skills and merge the documents. 2026-10-23: + the six pilot skills (subtraction sub_50/100/1k/10k/100k/1m _no_regroup; 0 findings).
